subject: NovaRetail pilot outcomes & quick reference ask
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovaRetail pilot outcomes & quick reference ask

Hi Anya —

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with our latency-aware routing profile. Quick recap of the core outcomes on your workload (attached PDF):

- 42% reduction in average token cost per inference compared to your previous endpoint (3.8c -> 2.2c)
- 1.6x throughput improvement for typical 512-token requests at 95ms p50 (measured under steady-state load)
- 98.9% success rate with our fallback-to-compact-model policy during peak bursts

We wanted to check two things:
1) Would you be open to a 10–15 minute call next week to capture a two-line customer quote and confirm the headline metrics for a short case snippet?
2) Alternatively, if email is easier, could you reply with a two-sentence blurb we can use (e.g., impact + one number)?

If it helps, we drafted a short one-liner in the linked doc and attached the metrics PDF for internal review. No obligation — happy to keep this off your public site if you prefer just a brief internal testimonial.

Attachments: Pilot_Metrics_NovaRetail_Q2.pdf (summary), NovaRetail_onepager_snapshot.png (visual)

Thanks again — we appreciate how collaborative your ops team was during the run.

— Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

From: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@novaretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Chen <sam.chen@novaretail.com>
Date: 2029-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaRetail pilot outcomes & quick reference ask

Mina —

Appreciate the clear recap and the PDF. The numbers look right to us; I shared the one-pager with our engineering lead (copied Sam) and legal for a quick check. Happy to do a short live call — 15 minutes works. I have availability:

- Tue 9/17 between 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 9/18 between 14:30–15:30 PT

If you’d prefer to start with a quick email blurb, here’s a rough two-liner you can refine: "Working with Redwood reduced our inference cost and improved throughput during peak traffic, enabling us to deliver faster responses to shoppers without increasing infrastructure spend."

Feel free to adjust.

— Anya
Head of Platform Ops, NovaRetail
anya.petrov@novaretail.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Thanks Anya — great, appreciate the draft line. Can we pencil Tue 9/17 at 10:15 PT for a 12–15 minute sync? Marcus from our product team will join to capture any technical notes for the case snippet.

Marcus / Laura — quick ask: if we get permission to publish a short quote and a 1-paragraph outcome summary, can the marketing team run a very concise draft by legal (NovaRetail) within 48 hours? I’ll share the Google Doc with a minimal publish-ready blurb.

Link to draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-case-study-draft (view/comment)

(attachment: Pilot_Metrics_NovaRetail_Q2.pdf)

— Mina
